title: Pixtt Kretv Krakxt
summary: Kretv Krakxt repeatedly sheds a husk and releases stronger brood waves.
overview: Kretv Krakxt repeatedly sheds a husk and releases stronger brood waves.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Clear each brood fully and save raid recovery for the final area-rampage stage.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At 90%, 70%, 50% and 30% health, the boss disappears into a husk and releases four, five, six and seven hatchlings respectively.
Kill the full brood to restore the boss; additional roaming reflections complicate later stages.
At 10%, three hatchlings appear while the boss remains active, switches to area rampage and begins a 12-second spell cycle.
The room seals early in the encounter and punishes attempts to leave.

notes: Approval E330. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
